text:
carol: T-30m: Final launch readiness sweep — requesting explicit GO/NO-GO. Checklist below and quick signals please.

carol: Summary: canary deploy to 10% EU traffic, model v3.1.2 pinned for canary, autoscale warmups enabled, rollout plan in release notes link: https://internal/release/2026-03-21.

dave: +1 on docs, smoke tests ran in staging (passed). any alerts from perf?

alice: perf looks normal on staging: p95 token latency 120ms, mem healthy. I pushed a tiny rate-limit tweak to canary route (timeout 10s -> 8s).

bob: noted the timeout change. ops: any infra concerns?
deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] canary start: initiating canary pool (gpu-pool-eu-small)
```
deploy-bot: START canary: service=redwood-inference, version=v3.1.2, target=10%, region=eu-west-1
```

erin: oncall-ops: running quick KV-cache warming. I configured prefix cache for top-200 prompts.

carol: rollback criteria (quick notes):
- automatic rollback if error-rate > 3% for 3 consecutive minutes
- manual rollback if user-facing rate limit or retries spike > 5x baseline
- latency rollback if p95 > 500ms sustained for 5 minutes
- immediate rollback if model outputs unsafe tokens > threshold in evals

bob: add: if deployment causes >10% increase in cost/unit for sustained 1h, auto-alert and hold further rollout.

alice: canary smoke script:
```
curl -X POST https://canary.redwood/api/generate -d '{"prompt":"Hello world","max_tokens":10}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer xxxxx'
```
response sampling sanity: 200 OK, 10 tokens, no embed errors.

dave: I'm on monitoring. I'll watch the dashboard: per-route latency, errors, and the new canary cost meter.

oncall-bot: [oncall-bot] alert-check: no open Sev1 or Sev2 for the last 12h. Pager oncall: erin.

erin: I'll shadow metrics for first 20m. If anything suspicious ping #eng-oncall and DM me.

carol: pinlist: production pin set to v3.1.1 -> will move to v3.1.2 after successful canary + 30m stable. Manual approval required for full 100% rollout.

bob: who is final approver for full rollout?

carol: final approver = dave (release owner) or alice if dave unreachable.

dave: I can approve if canary passes 30m smoke and no rollback trigger. Otherwise NO-GO.

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] canary traffic ramp: 0% -> 10% (target reached). Warmup tokens: 12M sent to KV-cache.

alice: quick check: logs show 2 transient warnings about kernel selection; not impacting responses. Keeping an eye.

bobby: (typo) sorry — ignore.

bob: small nit: update release notes with the exact rollback command for on-call: `deploy-bot rollback --service redwood-inference --to v3.1.1 --reason "auto-rollback"`

carol: done, added to notes and pinned in thread. Also added manual emergency unpin steps.

dave: scanning canary metrics now — errors 0.2%, p95 130ms. No user-facing anomalies in synthetic checks.

erin: see small spike in RPS at +3m, handled by autoscale. No retries.

carol: small reminder: quiet window starts T+10m for 1h (no infra config changes during that window unless P0).

alice: ACK. will not push infra changes.

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] canary health summary @T+15m:
- success_rate=99.6%
- p95=135ms
- errors=0.4% (transient, low volume)
- cost_delta=+2.1% (within expected)

carol: based on canary health I'm calling this GO-to-start staggered ramp to 50% after 30m stable. dave will make final call at T+30m.

dave: I am giving conditional GO. Wait for T+30m, then we'll ramp to 50% and monitor for another 30m.

erin: posting watchlist to #incidents in case we need a rapid rollback channel.

oncall-bot: [oncall-bot] reminder: If rollback triggered, please escalate to #release-war-room and tag @carol @dave.

carol: thanks everyone — will reconvene at T+30m here. Please keep replies short and signal any metric breaches. :rocket:
